# Vendored libraries

## Lenis

- Version: 1.3.27
- Source: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
- License: MIT, see `lenis/LICENSE`
- File: `lenis/lenis.min.js`

## GSAP

GSAP is not vendored in this repository. The site loads GSAP, ScrollTrigger, and SplitText from jsDelivr with a pinned version and Subresource Integrity hashes.

- Version: 3.15.0
- Source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
- License: GSAP standard license, https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/

The pinned URLs and hashes are in the `<head>` of `index.html`.
